title: The sandbox's last-resort harness default is omp; make it pi
description: Filed from ticfac yoh finding 13e4137e (uqi). cloud/sandbox/common.sh and worker.sh default TICKS_HARNESS to omp. The factory always sets TICKS_HARNESS (ticfac pins RUN_HARNESS=pi since uqi), so this is a last resort only - but the operator's rule is pi on GLM in the cloud. Changing the default ripples through ~12 internal/sandbox tests whose stubs assume omp (BIN=omp, cloudflare-ai-gateway provider naming); they need to set TICKS_HARNESS=omp explicitly or be rewritten for pi.
acceptance_criteria: An unset TICKS_HARNESS boots pi; every internal/sandbox test that relies on omp sets TICKS_HARNESS=omp explicitly; go test ./internal/sandbox/ passes
